modern: Come back to your sober senses and call yourself back; and when you have woken from sleep and seen that it was only dreams that troubled you, now in your waking hours look at the things around you as you looked at the dreams.
original: Return to thy sober senses and call thyself back; and when thou hast roused thyself from sleep and hast perceived that they were only dreams which troubled thee, now in thy waking hours look at these [the things about thee] as thou didst look at those [the dreams].
notification: Come back to your sober senses and call yourself back…
notification_original: Return to thy sober senses and call thyself back…
